capabilities: Render a dashboard of cards below a markdown transaction table
Chart monthly spending by hierarchical categories
Track per-category budgets with limits set in frontmatter
Track savings in multiple currencies and monthly saving goals
List the month's largest expenses with share of total
extras: The README is written in Russian; table column headers are recognized in both Russian and English. Table order is free, only the Amount column is required, and missing Day cells inherit the nearest earlier day.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a regular markdown table of income and expenses into an automatic finance dashboard with charts and budgets.
summary: Personal finance tracker that renders a spending dashboard (totals, category charts, budgets, savings) below a plain markdown transaction table.
